name: Shokuzai no Yagi
source:
When Saruwata catches a call of invitation to a reunion party, 
a dark memory of bullying in his school life comes into his mind.
Soon he gets a determined motivation to take revenge!

His only purpose is to completely destroy the happy families of bullies!
His vengeance will be accomplished by means of r*ping their daughters...
On their ways home, in warehouse, park, restroom... He r*pes everywhere!
Girls fall victim to Saruwata's venomous fangs one by one...
What will happen in the last scene of this revenge tragedy?!

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE218280.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
当猿渡接到邀请参加聚会的电话时，
他的脑海中浮现出学校生活中受欺凌的黑暗记忆。
很快他就有了报仇的坚定动力！

他的目的只有一个，就是彻底摧毁恶霸的幸福家庭！
他的复仇将通过强奸他们的女儿来完成……
在回家的路上，在仓库，在公园，在洗手间……他到处都是！
少女们一一沦为猿渡毒牙的牺牲品……
这场复仇悲剧的最后一幕会发生什么？！
